# Nested coverage

## When to use
### Trigger
Use this skill when a local skill needs review.

## Inputs
### Required files
Provide a SKILL.md file.

## Tools
### Commands
Run Node.js locally.

## Side effects
### Boundaries
This skill is read-only and local-only.

## Approval
### Before changes
Ask the user for approval before publishing any result.

## Examples
### Basic
Run `skillcheck SKILL.md`.

## Validation
### Automated checks
Preview the report locally.

## Limitations
### Scope
Only Markdown skills are supported.
